name: Namaiki Android
source:
In the future, even ordinary people can order sex robots.
One man purchased the silver-haired, busty, and kind "Yuki".
However, although her looks were exactly as he ordered, 
they mis-programmed her with a saucy and cocky attitude by accident!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE249943.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
未来，即使是普通人也可以订购性爱机器人。
一名男子购买了银发、丰满、善良的“Yuki”。
然而，虽然她的容貌完全符合他的要求，
他们一不小心就给她设定了一个傲慢的态度！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE249943.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
